title: Whole-system comparison for a fixed normalized quotient model
statement: Fix l, E, W, a coefficient derived-system calculus S, an ordinary quotient model M and a compatible derived model D [def-trf-completion-unit-models]. For arbitrary complexes P and C, let e:S.reduction(QP) isomorphic to QC and kappa_n:evaluation_n(C) isomorphic to finite reduction_n(P). If (e,kappa) is whole-system adjunction-coherent [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], there exists a strict isomorphism a:M(P) -> C with D.reductionComparison_P followed by Q(a) equal to e, and evaluation_n(a) followed by kappa_n equal to M.evaluation_n for every n. M and D are supplied, rather than constructed; the equality is in the entire derived system category before total derived limit.

source.place: Ordinary tensor/restriction adjunction (03D7), derived adjunction (06YY) and strict tower limit normalization (0941); indicated subargument of lem-trf-coherent-quotient-reduction-comparison.

proof.text: Unpack coherence to obtain its strict tower map b, its generator formulas and the double-transpose equality for e. Apply ordinary reconstruction to obtain a strict isomorphism a and all finite comparison equalities, together with its ordinary transposition formula.

Normalize the derived constant-tower counit against D.limitUnit. For a K-injective tower use D.limitUnit_normalization and integralComparisonTowerCounit_computes, cancelling the canonical right-derived computation isomorphism. Both sides are natural transformations, so extend equality to every complex using a K-injective resolution and cancelling its invertible localization.

The two ordinary termwise limit comparisons agree by their projections. D.hom_normalization, D.systemUnit_composition, the normalized counit and naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors show that the double transpose of D.reductionComparison followed by Q(a) is Q(b), with the prescribed factor isomorphisms. Coherence gives the same formula for e. Apply injectivity of the two adjunction Hom bijections to obtain the whole-system equality.

proof_origin.place: Proved subargument of the coherent quotient comparison, separated after profiling the complete file and simplifying its section and adjunction calculations.

theorem coherentQuotientModelComparison (W : Scheme.{t})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W) (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (D : CompletionUnit.DerivedModel l E W S M)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
    (e : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E W n).obj P)
    (hcoh : IsIntegralComparisonPresentationCoherent l E W S P C e κ) :
    ∃ a : (M.quotient l E W).obj P ≅ C,
      D.reductionComparison.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map a.hom = e.hom ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
          κ n = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).app P
